PublicPages.faqIntro: Clear answers about using Fridgy every day.
PublicPages.faqOneQ: How do I add food to Fridgy?
PublicPages.faqOneA: Scan a receipt and confirm the recognised products, or add products by hand.
PublicPages.faqTwoQ: Can I share my inventory with others at home?
PublicPages.faqTwoA: Yes. Create a household and invite others. You can share inventory, shopping lists and recipes.
PublicPages.faqThreeQ: Does Fridgy suggest recipes from my inventory?
PublicPages.faqThreeA: Yes. Suggestions take your household inventory into account. Always check ingredients before cooking.
PublicPages.faqFourQ: Can I set a diet and allergies?
PublicPages.faqFourA: Yes. Set your diet, allergens and excluded foods in settings to tailor suggestions.
PublicPages.faqFiveQ: How does the shopping list work?
PublicPages.faqFiveA: Add needed products to a shared list. You can also add missing ingredients from a recipe.
PublicPages.contactIntro: Have a question, an idea or a problem with Fridgy? Send us a message – we are happy to help.
PublicPages.aboutIntro: Fridgy started with a simple idea: food at home should be easier to manage.

privacy.providerDescription: The controller of personal data processed in connection with Fridgy is {name}. Use the contact details below for privacy questions and requests about your rights.

data.title: Data we process
data.body: We process your email, account ID, username and chosen profile image; household membership; inventory, shopping lists, recipes, dish images, favourites and cooking history; food preferences and correspondence. Infrastructure providers also process technical data such as IP addresses and request information. When you sign in with Google, we receive the data shared through that sign-in method.

purposes.title: Purposes and legal grounds
purposes.body: Account operation, service features, service-related support and billing are needed to perform the contract (GDPR Article 6(1)(b)). Tax and other legal obligations rely on Article 6(1)(c). Security, abuse prevention, general enquiries and legal claims are the controller's legitimate interests (Article 6(1)(f)). Processing that requires consent relies on the consent given, which you may withdraw.

preferences.title: Optional preferences and allergies
preferences.body: Account and order details are needed to provide the chosen service. Other information, including food preferences, is optional. Allergy information may reveal health data. Processing such data requires explicit consent under GDPR Article 9(2)(a). You can remove preferences in settings or by <contact>contacting us</contact>. Do not provide other people's data without authority.

sharing.title: Data shared within a household
sharing.body: Inventory, shopping lists, recipes, favourites and cooking history are shared within the household. The owner can access member details needed to manage the household, including usernames and email addresses. Personal preferences belong to your profile. Deleting an account does not delete all content shared with others; some content may remain in the household where it was added.

providers.title: Service providers and AI
providers.body: We use providers for hosting, sign-in, databases, file storage, AI and payments: {processors}. They receive data needed for their role. AI features send selected inventory, preferences and instructions, a receipt image or an imported recipe description. We do not save receipt images in Fridgy's file library; providers have separate retention rules. The payment provider handles payments; Fridgy does not store full card numbers. Data may be disclosed to authorised authorities where required by law.

transfers.title: Transfers outside the EEA
transfers.body: Providers or their subprocessors may process data outside the European Economic Area. Transfers require a GDPR mechanism, such as an adequacy decision or standard contractual clauses and any required additional safeguards. You may request details of the mechanism and a copy of the relevant safeguards by <contact>contacting the controller</contact>.

retention.title: How long we keep data
retention.body: We keep account and activity data while you use the service, then only as needed for legal obligations, accounting or legal claims. Correspondence is retained while handling the matter and for a justified period needed to document it. Security logs and backups follow periods determined by their purpose and infrastructure settings. AI recipes that are not favourites are removed after 7 days during library cleanup. Account and shared-content deletion takes other household members' rights into account.

storage.title: Cookies and browser storage
storage.body: We use session mechanisms for sign-in and save your chosen language, theme and colour palette. Language is stored in a cookie for up to a year; appearance settings remain in local browser storage until changed or deleted. Fridgy does not run advertising trackers or marketing cookies. You can manage storage in your browser; blocking essential mechanisms may prevent sign-in or saved preferences.

rights.title: Your rights and complaints
rights.body: Subject to GDPR conditions, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction and portability, and object to processing. Withdrawing consent does not affect earlier lawful processing. <contact>Write to the controller</contact>; we normally respond within a month and explain any justified extension. You may complain to the <authority>Polish data protection authority</authority> or your competent authority. Fridgy does not make solely automated decisions about you that produce legal or similarly significant effects.

changes.title: Policy changes
changes.body: The current policy is available at this address with its update date. We will explain significant processing changes in the app or by email before applying them and obtain separate consent where required by law. Policy changes do not limit your data rights.

terms.providerDescription: Fridgy is provided by {name}, referred to as the Provider. Use the details below for contact, complaints, withdrawal from a contract and account matters.

service.title: Service scope and requirements
service.body: Fridgy helps manage household inventory, shopping lists, recipes and cooking. It includes shared households, recipe imports, receipt analysis and AI suggestions according to the chosen plan. You need internet access, an up-to-date browser with JavaScript and essential session mechanisms, and access to email or a supported sign-in account. Data processing is described in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

account.title: Account and contract
account.body: The account agreement is formed when the account is created and these terms are accepted. Provide accurate details and protect access to your email and sign-in account. Do not share sign-in codes. You must have the legal capacity required to enter the agreement; obtain a legal representative's consent where required before using the service. You may save or print this page at no charge.

households.title: Shared households and roles
households.body: Data added to a household is available to its authorised members. The owner manages membership, the plan and payments and may transfer ownership. Each household has its own plan and shared limits. Invite only people entitled to access the shared data. Before deleting an owner's account in a household with other members, ownership must be transferred or the other memberships ended.

plans.title: Free, Premium and the trial
plans.body: Free has no charge. Premium features, prices and limits are shown in the <pricing>pricing page</pricing> before purchase. The trial lasts {trialDays} days with Premium limits, needs no card and does not automatically become paid; without a purchase, the household returns to Free. Monthly allowances reset on the billing cycle date, including for annual plans, and do not roll over. Free's one-time AI allowance does not reset.

billing.title: Payments, renewal and cancellation
billing.body: Buying Premium is a separate contract made after the price, period, renewal terms and payment obligation are shown and the order is confirmed. Plans are billed monthly or yearly and renew under the accepted terms. <settings>Plan settings</settings> show dates and let you cancel renewal. Access lasts until the paid period ends. Moving to Free keeps data and existing members' access; adding above limits requires space or Premium. A payment problem may suspend Premium after notice of the issue.

withdrawal.title: Right to withdraw
withdrawal.body: A consumer entering a distance contract may generally withdraw within 14 days of conclusion without giving a reason. Send a clear statement using the Provider's details, including by <contact>email</contact>; no special form is required. Applicable law governs withdrawal effects and refunds. Canceling Premium renewal alone is not withdrawal from the contract. These rules do not limit broader rights under the consumer's applicable law.

content.title: User content and permitted use
content.body: You retain rights to your own content. You grant the Provider a non-exclusive right to store, process and share it with authorised household members as needed to provide the service. Upload only content you have the necessary rights to use, including imports from other services. Illegal content, privacy violations, bypassing safeguards or limits and disrupting the app are prohibited. Any justified account restriction must be proportionate; we will explain the reason and how to challenge it unless the law prevents this.

safety.title: AI, food dates and responsibility
safety.body: AI output, estimated use-by dates, nutrition values and ingredient matching may contain errors. Before confirming, check receipt data, recipes, allergens, quantities, package dates and the actual condition of food. Fridgy does not replace food safety judgement or individual medical or dietary advice. Technology limits do not exclude the Provider's responsibility for contractual conformity or rights that consumers cannot waive.

complaints.title: Complaints and conformity
complaints.body: <contact>Send a complaint</contact> describing the issue, when it occurred, your request and reply details. No special form is required. We respond to consumer complaints within 14 days unless applicable law provides otherwise. Statutory digital-service remedies, including conformity, price reduction or withdrawal where legally available, are not limited by these terms. Information on out-of-court dispute resolution is available from <consumer>UOKiK</consumer>; participation follows the rules of the relevant procedure.

termination.title: Ending use and your data
termination.body: You can stop using your account, delete it in settings and export available data beforehand. Shared households follow the owner rules and protect others' content. Canceling renewal and deleting an account are separate actions; settle active billing before closing an account. AI recipes not marked as favourites may be removed after 7 days. You can also send statutory data or contract-termination requests to the <contact>Provider</contact>.

changes.title: Changes and applicable law
changes.body: Changes may result from law, security or service changes. Changes affecting an existing contract will be notified in advance on a durable medium, with the reason, date and applicable rights, including termination where required. We do not change the price of a paid period retrospectively. Polish law applies without removing mandatory consumer protection under the law of habitual residence. Courts have jurisdiction as provided by law.
